name: TribesPad
game: Tribes 2 (PC), Starsiege: Tribes 1.41 and Tribes: Vengeance
notes: TribesPad owns its release recipe. All three games are built by default: the build downloads the free official Tribes 2 installer, the TribesNEXT client, PlayT1's Starsiege: Tribes 1.41 installer and the Revengeance release of Tribes: Vengeance, and checks them by SHA-256, so there is no game file to select. On iPhone and iPad, Tribes: Vengeance is an optional download inside the app (its picker card); the Mac app carries it. Personal builds contain translated game code and the game data and are never published. iPhone and iPad builds without a Mac: Actions → Build TribesPad for iPhone and iPad in a fork of the repository.

commands: brew install llvm@20 cmake ninja sevenzip zstd innoextract

steps: Open TribesPad and choose a game from the picker. Starsiege: Tribes and Tribes 2 are inside; Tribes: Vengeance is an optional download: tap its card, then Download (3.1 GB; it needs about 15 GB free while it installs and keeps 11 GB). Tap the controller button to show touch controls.

For Tribes 2, sign in with your TribesNEXT account (CREATE NEW ACCOUNT makes a free one), then PLAY GAME → JOIN lists the internet servers. You join as an observer: press Fire (RT on a controller) to join a team. To start offline, turn off Settings → Online Play in the ··· menu, then choose LAN GAME → HOST, enable bots and start a match.

For Starsiege: Tribes, choose TRAINING for bots or HOST MULTIPLAYER for a local game. JOIN lists community servers; ··· → Play Online shows who is playing. Use ··· → Choose Game… and reopen TribesPad to return to the picker.

For Tribes: Vengeance, NEW GAME starts the campaign; MULTIPLAYER → JOIN lists the internet servers (··· → Play Online → Server List opens it). TribesPad gives the game a community CD key the first time it is needed.
Unzip {file}, move TribesPad to your Applications folder and open it. It needs no Apple account. Choose Starsiege: Tribes, Tribes 2 or Tribes: Vengeance from the game picker.

For Tribes: Vengeance, NEW GAME starts the campaign; MULTIPLAYER → JOIN lists the internet servers. TribesPad gives the game a community CD key the first time it is needed.
